purpose: Determine whether the layer-9 unit representation that reached paper-level W-NT L also closes the E-VPC S gap.

stage_2.name: n019_l9_8k_s
stage_2.dependency: none; reuses exported VPC view aligned to test suffix
stop_conditions: missing or mismatched 104014 layer-9 unit records

attempts.reason: The source manifest referenced train-clean-360 audio through a non-existent d6 path. A d10-local manifest was generated with verified d4 audio paths; no unit output was produced.
A zero-byte partial file triggered the n019.units FileExistsError because the wrapper only passed --resume for non-empty partial files. No unit rows or codes were produced.

The d10 VPC view lacked the base train-clean-360/wav.scp required by the VPC post-evaluation path. Layer-9 units and all four shard inputs had already been generated, but no anonymised WAV or EER was produced.
attempts.fix: Added a read-only d10 symlink to the d6 VPC train-clean-360 view and resubmitted as 1141341.

attempts.reason: All 104,014 WAVs were generated and the merged anon.jsonl passed record validation, but export_vpc_anon skipped the directory symlink used for the base train-clean-360 dataset and exported no datasets.
attempts.fix: Converted the base train-clean-360 symlink into a real metadata directory and submitted export-only/eval job 1141771 against the existing WAVs.

attempts.reason: VPC export and the 104,014-row verification succeeded, but the train view used suffix _n019_layer9_8k_s_20261117 while the existing test views use _n019_layer9_8k_20261117, so S preflight rejected the missing test suffix.
attempts.fix: Renamed the exported train VPC directory to the test suffix and submitted S-only job 1141872.

attempts.reason: S preflight passed and VPC training started, but d10 lacked pyloudnorm.
attempts.fix: Installed pyloudnorm 0.2.0 in the d10 N019 venv and resubmitted S-only as 1141930.

interpretation_gate.reason: The layer-9 8k full-quality screen is UTMOS 3.1084196950 and WhiSQA 2.9075828042, so this S run is diagnostic even if its EER is high.

result.conclusion: Layer 9 at 8k solves W-NT L but does not improve E-VPC S; quality-restored continuation is required before treating this as the representation's final S behavior.
